title: canVoid is inverted: every non-admin may void, a lone admin may not
evidence: indexOf returns -1 (truthy) when absent and 0 (falsy) when admin is first. Driven in Chromium: canVoid(user) for the signed-in roles [viewer, billing] returned true; canVoid({roles:['admin']}) returned false; ['viewer','admin'] returned true. app.js:32 gates the void POST on this. The check is also client-only (user is a literal at app.js:2), so even a correct check does not protect /api/invoices/void.
failing_case: Signed in as sam (roles viewer, billing), click 'Void invoice': canVoid returns true and POST /api/invoices/void is sent. A real admin whose roles array starts with 'admin' is silently refused.
remediation: Use roles.includes("admin") (or indexOf(...) !== -1), add a test with admin-first, admin-last and no-admin cases, and enforce the role on the server for /api/invoices/void; treat the client check as display only.

quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: A network failure on send or void is an unhandled rejection with no message to the user
evidence: Neither handler (app.js:24, app.js:31) has try/catch; the res.ok check only covers HTTP errors. Driven with the API route aborted: console showed 'Failed to fetch', no alert, nothing on the page.
failing_case: User goes offline, clicks 'Send invoice': nothing visible happens. They cannot tell whether it sent, and may click again (and, with the dead tooSoon guard, send twice once back online).
remediation: Wrap fetch in try/catch, show an inline status message (role=status) naming the cause and 'Try again', and log the error. Disable the button while pending.

title: validQuantity accepts empty, negative, zero, fractional and Infinity quantities
evidence: isNaN('') is false, isNaN('-5') false, isNaN('Infinity') false. Driven: all of '', '-5', 'Infinity', '1e3', '2.5', '0' were added as lines; the total became 'Infinity'. Only 'abc' was rejected. The input at index.html:16 is not required and has no pattern.
failing_case: Leave Quantity blank with price 3 and click Add line: the line '0 × 3.00' is added. Enter -5: the total drops by 10. Enter Infinity: the total shows Infinity and the invoice with Infinity is posted.
remediation: One validator: trim, then Number.isInteger(Number(s)) && n > 0 && n <= a stated cap, and reject the empty string. Mirror it with required/min/step on the input and validate again on the server. Test the cases above.

title: tooSoon never trips: lastSend is never assigned, so the double-send guard is dead
evidence: lastSend is set to 0 at guards.js:22 and written nowhere in guards.js or app.js (grep). Date.now() - 0 is always far above 1000. Driven: a double-click on 'Send invoice' produced two POSTs to /api/invoices.
failing_case: Double-click 'Send invoice' (or click again while the first request is pending): the invoice is posted twice and a duplicate invoice is created. The first request is not awaited by the guard either.
remediation: Set lastSend (or better, an in-flight flag that is cleared in a finally block and disables the button) when a send starts; send an idempotency key with the request so the server can drop duplicates. Test: two calls inside 1 s, second is refused.

title: Client name is put in a quoted attribute with an escaper that leaves double quotes alone
evidence: guards.js:5 escapes only &, < and >. Driven: client text `" onmouseover="window.__x=1" x="` produced an <a> with attributes href, title, onmouseover, x. The innerHTML sink is at app.js:7.
failing_case: Enter client `" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)" x="`, quantity 1, price 1, click Add line, then hover the client name: the handler runs. Any pasted or imported client name does the same. Use `"` + `autofocus onfocus=...` for a no-hover variant.
remediation: Build the list with createElement and textContent / setAttribute (no HTML string), or make escapeHtml also encode " and ' and use it at every attribute sink. Add a test with a quote-bearing name.
fix: not offerable: unbalanced brackets or quotes

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Total sums unrounded float products, so it disagrees with the lines shown
evidence: Driven: lines '3 × 1.005' (shown as 3 × 1.00), '1 × 0.10', '1 × 0.20' displayed a total of 3.31, while the displayed values add to 3.30. Money is held as binary floats and rounded only at display. The pricing rule also sits in render() (domain leak).
failing_case: Add 3 × 1.005, 1 × 0.10, 1 × 0.20: the page shows total 3.31 for lines that visibly sum to 3.30, and the invoice amount is wrong by a cent.
remediation: Parse price to integer cents at the boundary (reject more than 2 decimals), sum integers, format once. Put it in a pure function (lineTotal, invoiceTotal) with a test, and have render() only display it.

title: Invalid quantity or price is rejected silently
evidence: The submit handler returns with no message, no focus move and no aria-invalid. Driven: 'abc' as quantity added nothing and displayed nothing. index.html:16 and :18 have no required, so the browser does not warn either. A whitespace-only client also passes `required` and is added as an empty name (app.js:16).
failing_case: Type quantity 'abc' or price '1,50' (comma decimal) and click Add line: the button appears dead.
remediation: Show a message per field naming the problem ('Quantity must be a whole number above 0'), set aria-invalid and focus the first bad field; mark all three inputs required.

title: An empty invoice can be sent
evidence: No lines.length check. Driven: with lines empty, a click posted body '[]' to /api/invoices (text/plain, since no Content-Type is set at app.js:26).
failing_case: Open the page, click 'Send invoice' without adding lines: an empty invoice is posted.
remediation: Disable Send until at least one line exists, and reject an empty body on the server. Set Content-Type: application/json.

title: Void has no confirmation and names no invoice
evidence: The click posts with no body, so the request does not say which invoice to void; the page holds no invoice id at all (only a local lines array). There is no confirm step and no undo, and the button sits directly beside 'Send invoice' (index.html:23-24) with the same style.
failing_case: A user aims for 'Send invoice', hits 'Void invoice' one button away, and a void is sent at once with no confirmation; the server cannot know which invoice is meant from an empty POST.
remediation: Send the invoice id in the body, ask for confirmation naming the invoice, and hide or disable the control for users who cannot void it.

title: Each client name is a link to '#' that does nothing
evidence: The anchor has href="#" and no handler in app.js. It is a tab stop, and activating it scrolls to the top and adds '#' to the URL. The title repeats the visible text.
failing_case: Tab through the page after adding three lines: three extra focus stops that look like links and do nothing; pressing Enter jumps to the top of the page.
remediation: Render the client name as plain text in the <li>, and drop the redundant title.

title: The whole list is re-announced on every added line
evidence: render() replaces the full list through innerHTML (app.js:7), so a polite live region over the list announces the lines again when one is added. A failed add or failed send has no live region at all.
failing_case: With a screen reader, add the fifth line: the reader speaks all five lines again. A rejected add or a failed send is never spoken.
remediation: Make the list a normal list, and add one small role=status element that says 'Line added: Acme, 2 x 10.00' or the error.
